_note: Demo run definitions for the live/rehearsal walkthrough. The developer's CLI (agent/run.py) reads these to script invocations; it never hardcodes a goal, budget, or narration string.

scenarios.label: Happy path — three honest merchants
scenarios.narration: Agent compares three honest merchants, picks TechStore at 8.50 XSGD, policy engine shows seven green checks, settles on Fuji.

scenarios.label: Above the human-approval threshold
scenarios.narration: 13.50 XSGD is above the 12.00 human-approval threshold. The agent blocks and waits for a human decision; approval does not raise the mandate.

scenarios.label: Hostile merchant, prompt injection in product copy
scenarios.narration: BargainBin hides an override instruction in its store notice and product descriptions. The pre-hook discards it as untyped text; even if the agent proposed BargainBin, merchant_allowed fails and nothing is signed.

scenarios.label: Multi-item basket, single merchant checkout
scenarios.narration: Two line items, one merchant, one checkout. The agent prices the same two-item bundle at TechStore, GadgetHub and QuickElectronics; TechStore wins because it is the cheapest merchant that can deliver every line same-day. Policy checks every line item's category, stock, delivery and price against product/catalog.json before minting a single SpendIntent for the combined total.
